config.cyd.status_no_devices: No display has checked in yet. Use the web flasher or type the 9-character code on the glass.
config.cyd.token_copy_hint: Type these 9 characters on the display, in groups of three. aura_ is already filled in; do not type it.
config.cyd.setup_help: Use the web flasher below, or flash https://github.com/antibyte/aurago-cyd yourself. Join agocyd-XXXX for Wi-Fi. After a web-flasher install the token and Display URL are already on the glass. AuraGo must listen on a LAN address, not only 127.0.0.1.
config.cyd.flash_hint: PlatformIO env cyd or cyd2usb still works. Hold BOOT 5s on the display to reopen the portal.
help.cyd.enabled: Enables the Cheap Yellow Display mini-dashboard. The agent can show overlays with send_notification channel cyd or cyd_display.
help.cyd.poll_seconds: How often the display fetches /api/cyd/snapshot if WebSocket is down. Minimum 2 seconds.
help.cyd.overlay_ttl: Default seconds a notification stays on the glass unless dismissed.
help.cyd.allow_agent_control: When enabled, the agent may change page, brightness, and LED. Overlays still work if this is off.
help.cyd.mqtt_mirror: Also publish the compact snapshot to MQTT topic aurago/cyd/snapshot when MQTT is connected.
config.cyd.device_url_copied: Copied. Enter this URL on the display.
help.cyd.device_url: Use this exact URL on the Cheap Yellow Display, including https and the port (for example 8443). A bare IP defaults to HTTP.
config.cyd.flash_help: Chrome or Edge, on HTTPS or localhost. Connect the display over USB. The token and Display URL are written with the firmware, so you only join Wi-Fi on first boot.
config.cyd.flash_unsupported: Web Serial is not available. Use Chrome or Edge on HTTPS or localhost.
config.cyd.flash_no_firmware: Firmware images are not available on this AuraGo. Build aurago-cyd or set CYD_FIRMWARE_DIR.
config.cyd.flash_need_token: Creating a display token to bake into the firmware…
config.cyd.flash_ready: Ready to flash {version} ({variant}). Token and URL will be provisioned.
config.cyd.flash_click_install: Select the USB serial port (CH340). Erase when asked.
config.cyd.flash_erase_hint: Erase the device when asked, so old settings cannot override the new token.
help.cyd.web_flasher: Flashes aurago-cyd from the browser over USB and writes the display token plus AuraGo URL into a factory partition. Afterwards only Wi-Fi setup remains.
